panels.title: Overview
panels.description: Running activities only (running, trail running, treadmill running, indoor running).
One point per running activity; END marker rows have no distance and are not counted.

targets.query: SELECT COUNT("distance") AS "Runs" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /^(running|trail_running|treadmill_running|indoor_running)$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Runs

targets.query: SELECT SUM("distance") AS "Distance" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /^(running|trail_running|treadmill_running|indoor_running)$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.description: Sum of movingDuration (timer time), not elapsed wall time.

targets.query: SELECT SUM("movingDuration") AS "Moving Time" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /^(running|trail_running|treadmill_running|indoor_running)$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Moving Time

panels.description: Sum of the per-lap ascent fields.

targets.query: SELECT SUM("Ascent") AS "Elevation Gain" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivityName" =~ /^(running|trail_running|treadmill_running|indoor_running)$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Elevation Gain

panels.description: Distance-weighted average over the range, in minutes per kilometre.

targets.query: SELECT (SUM("movingDuration")*1000)/(SUM("distance")*60) AS "Pace" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /^(running|trail_running|treadmill_running|indoor_running)$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Average Pace

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("averageHR") AS "Avg HR" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /^(running|trail_running|treadmill_running|indoor_running)$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT "distance" AS "Distance" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /^(running|trail_running|treadmill_running|indoor_running)$/ AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC

panels.description: Minutes per kilometre for each run.

targets.query: SELECT (1000*("movingDuration"/"distance"))/60 AS "Pace" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /^(running|trail_running|treadmill_running|indoor_running)$/ AND "distance" > 0 AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Average Pace per Run

targets.query: SELECT "averageHR" AS "Avg HR" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /^(running|trail_running|treadmill_running|indoor_running)$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT COUNT("distance") AS "Runs" FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE "activityType" =~ /^(running|trail_running|treadmill_running|indoor_running)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(7d) fill(0)

panels.title: Running dynamics (per-run averages)
panels.description: Requires `running_dynamics` in FETCH_SELECTION (see README). These panels stay empty otherwise.
Per-run average, millimetres.

targets.query: SELECT "avg_vertical_oscillation" AS "Vertical Oscillation" FROM "RunningDynamics" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Vertical Oscillation

panels.description: Per-run average, percent (lower is more economical).

targets.query: SELECT "avg_vertical_ratio" AS "Vertical Ratio" FROM "RunningDynamics" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Vertical Ratio

panels.description: Per-run average, milliseconds.

targets.query: SELECT "avg_stance_time" AS "Ground Contact Time" FROM "RunningDynamics" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Ground Contact Time

panels.description: Per-run average, millimetres.

targets.query: SELECT "avg_step_length" AS "Stride Length" FROM "RunningDynamics" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Stride Length

panels.description: Per-run average, strides per minute.

targets.query: SELECT "avg_running_cadence" AS "Cadence" FROM "RunningDynamics" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Running Cadence

panels.description: Share of ground contact time spent on the left foot (50% is balanced).

targets.query: SELECT "avg_stance_time_balance" AS "Left %" FROM "RunningDynamics" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Ground Contact Balance

panels.title: Laps
panels.description: Per-lap averages for the selected run, as recorded by the watch.
Cadence, stride and dynamics columns require `running_dynamics`.

targets.query: SELECT "Index" AS "Lap", "Distance" AS "Distance (m)", (1000/("Avg_Speed"))/60 AS "Pace (min/km)", "Avg_HR" AS "Avg HR", "Avg_Running_Cadence" AS "Cadence", "Avg_Step_Length" AS "Stride (mm)", "Avg_Vertical_Oscillation" AS "VO (mm)", "Avg_Vertical_Ratio" AS "VR (%)", "Avg_Stance_Time" AS "GCT (ms)", "Avg_Stance_Time_Balance" AS "GCT Bal (%)", "Avg_Stance_Time_Percent" AS "GCT (%)" FROM "ActivityLap" WHERE "ActivitySelector"::tag =~ /^$ActivitySelector$/ AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time ASC
